title: Recursive Insertion Sort
intuition: Recursively sort a[0..n-2], then insert a[n-1] into the sorted prefix — same insertion step as iterative.

approaches.title: Recursive insertion
approaches.idea: sort(n-1) then insert last element leftward.

followUps: Why insertion recurses naturally on prefixes?
interviewInsight: Recursive insertion mirrors the inductive proof of correctness.
